criteria.text: The top-level list contains only root sessions (`parent_session_id IS NULL`).
criteria.reason: Real HTTP list returned no seeded child as a top-level session.

criteria.text: A root session stays listed regardless of how many children it has spawned; LIMIT applies to roots.
criteria.reason: Real HTTP list retained the deliberately old root after 101 newer children were seeded.

criteria.text: Each returned root carries its delegated children in a nested field.
criteria.reason: Real HTTP response nested exactly all 101 seeded child IDs under the root with matching parentSessionId values.

criteria.text: Consider ordering by last_activity_at rather than created_at.
criteria.reason: Root quota now orders by COALESCE(last_activity_at, updated_at, created_at); the old root with newest activity remains listed behind 100 newer-created roots.

criteria.text: Nested descendants are bounded so a session-list refresh cannot return an unbounded recursive result.
criteria.reason: The recursive descendant read is capped at 500 rows and a 501-child fixture returns exactly 500.

criteria.text: Nested descendants obey the same archive, scope, and system predicates as their returned root and recursion is guarded.
criteria.reason: Archived, system, and cross-category children are excluded; UNION de-duplicates recursive IDs to terminate malformed cycles.
